body:
# Proof re-affirmation on the final main (scheduled, not yet routed)

Origin: operator finding qitem-20261003195113-5c2a4f97 (proof drift). Living shared
documents named as evidence (docs/qa/TRACEABILITY.md, docs/qa/GAPS.md,
docs/diagrams/erd.mmd, docs/qa/01-greenfield-core/release-judgments) keep changing
while missions 02 and 03 build, so already-accepted proof items read
"unknown: Evidence missing or changed". At 19:51Z: 01-create-redirect item 14;
02-analytics items 1, 4, 5, 10, 11, 13; 03-operate items 4, 5, 13.

## When

After the last slice of missions 02 and 03 has merged and main is green, and
before the final evidence export of either mission. The lead holds this row
until then and routes it to qa2-agent (or qa-agent if idle) with the final
main SHA filled in.

## The ask (for the QA seat that receives it)

1. Run `rig proof show <mission>/slices/<slice> --json` for every accepted
   slice of missions 01, 02 and 03 and list each item whose state is not
   accepted.
2. For each such item only, re-check it on the final main SHA against the
   evidence it names, and record a fresh attributed judgment with
   `rig proof judge`, citing that SHA.
3. An item whose evidence still holds reads accepted again. An item that no
   longer holds is a real regression: judge it as such and report it to the
   lead as a finding, not as drift.
4. Do not re-judge items that are already accepted; do not widen scope.

Evidence: a short table under docs/qa/ (slice, item, before, after, SHA,
reason) committed with an explicit pathspec.
summary: Scheduled: proof re-affirmation of drifted items on the final main (missions 01-03), to route to qa2-agent after the last merge, before the final evidence export
